title: Lost Mary Nera15K Grape Ice Prefilled Vape Pods
description: The Grape Ice Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pod delivers a sweet burst of ripe Grape balanced by a smooth, icy exhale. The fruit note is rich and juicy on the inhale, while the cooling finish adds a clean freshness that makes this blend both satisfying and easy to enjoy throughout the day. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 15ml Refill Pod that automatically tops up the pod as you vape. This refill system supports up to 15,000 puffs depending on usage and eliminates the need for messy refilling or coil changes. Fitted with a 0.6ohm mesh coil, the pod delivers consistent vapour and strong flavour clarity from first puff to last. Made for the Lost Mary Nera30K Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill pod into place and you’re ready to go. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
